name: worldmonitor
description: World Monitor agent plugin: live global-intelligence MCP servers plus task-focused agent skills for country risk, conflict, markets, chokepoints, energy, climate, and related situational awareness.

interface.longDescription: Explore country risk, conflicts, markets, energy and maritime chokepoints with live WorldMonitor data. Inspect gold positioning and holdings, traffic anomalies and global DDoS observations. Compare dated CPI and rate histories, research stocks and technical backtests, and model energy or import-cost exposure to chokepoint closures. Research and scenario results retain model limitations and do not establish future performance. News results list headlines from publishers' public RSS feeds with the publisher's name, the time and a link to the original article; WorldMonitor does not summarize, rewrite or reproduce articles. Open a headline dashboard and a 2D map or 3D globe of events. Data can be partial, stale or unavailable; answers retain coverage and attribution. Sign in with your WorldMonitor account through OAuth. Research generation may save shared snapshots. The plugin does not trade, publish articles or change account settings. Map controls work in the UI; model control of an already-open map depends on host support.
capabilities: Inspect events on a map or globe
Model chokepoint supply and cost exposure
defaultPrompt: Show today’s world headlines with links to the sources.
What is the current risk picture for Taiwan?
How exposed is Japan’s oil supply to a Strait of Hormuz closure?
